rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out (label far too short for the crop width), plus D:column_crossing_line/column_merge_line lines (two verse columns joined).
notes: This is a 1930 polytonic book of verse and prose about Galatia/Ankara. The random lines (1-20) match the print, polytonic marks included; spacing breathings (2, 9, 11) are covered by the pool rule. A describable subset is wrong. In 22, 24, 34, 35 and 39 the crop is a full printed line, but the label is a short fragment of a neighbouring line (e.g. 22 'νῦν, φέρω ὧδε, ὑπὸ τὸν' under 'Ἐπὶ τῇ συλλήψει τῶν Ρωμηῶν Ἀγκύρας...'). All of these carry C:cpp_vs_book_out. In 21, 27, 32 and 33 two side-by-side verse columns are joined in one line. This book is in the test split.
